newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Hospital buys Melbourne hospital.
newsitem.headline: Australian Hospital buys Melbourne hospital.

text.p: Private hospital operator Australian Hospital Care Ltd said on Friday it has bought the 50-bed Victorian Rehabilitation Centre in Glen Waverley in Melbourne's eastern suburbs.
AHX said the hospital, owned by the Transport Accident Commission, was built in the early 1970s and operated both inpatient and outpatient services.
AHX announced last week it had bought the Lady Davidson Hospital in Sydney's North Shore from the Department of Veteran's Affairs.
The purchase of the two hospitals, including planned upgrade expenses over the next 12-24 months, would cost A$20-A$25 million, it said.
Both purchases would be funded by debt facilities.
AHX said it expected the acquisitions to be earnings per share positive in the 1997/98 financial year ended June 30, with further contributions following the upgrade of the facilities.
The latest purchase would offer synergies with other AHX hopsital in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, it said.
